text:
Situation: Docetaxel 160 mg/8 mL is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Ingenus Pharmaceuticals LLC discontinued its docetaxel injection with an initial posting date of 2026-02-20 and an update date of 2026-02-20, citing a business decision to discontinue manufacture. Corvale East holds 52 vials at 2.5 vials per day, providing 21 days on hand. Corvale General holds 81 vials at 2.9 vials per day, providing 27.9 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list shows docetaxel is not listed as of 2026-10-21. Ingenus Pharmaceuticals LLC discontinued its docetaxel injection with an initial posting date of 2026-02-20 and an update date of 2026-02-20, citing a business decision to discontinue manufacture.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately three to four weeks at present usage rates. No FDA shortage listing exists. Multiple alternative manufacturers are not on FDA's shortage list today.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Accord Healthcare Inc. (needs: buyer approval).
2. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Actavis Pharma, Inc. (needs: buyer approval).
3. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc. (needs: buyer approval).
4. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited (needs: buyer approval).
5. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Avyxa Pharma, LLC (needs: buyer approval).

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or protocol modifications at this time.
